To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a novel molecular mechanism of bone formation was identified in FOP.

(i) the FOP mutation leads to constitutive phosphorylation of ACVR1, which is sufficient to induce the formation of ectopic bone, (ii) a small molecule that binds to ACVR1 and inhibits its activity can prevent the ectopic bone formation, and (iii) the inhibition of ACVR1 activity by the small molecule is sufficient to rescue the phenotype of a FOP mouse model.
